description: Link a store to the commerce pipeline: platform is one of the platforms list_commerce_connectors offers. Store credentials go in credentials; they are kept encrypted and never returned, but they do pass through this conversation, so use a key made for the purpose. The metadata also sets where competitor prices come from. Needs the owner or admin role and a Last Price credential with commerce configure scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

metadata.description: Platform settings, including where competitor prices come from.

platform.description: The store platform, e.g. memory for a demo store.

name: create_commerce_connector
